actual.titulo: The Many Lives of Benjaman Kyle • Nowhere Man

lista.titulo: Signs of a Psychopath • My Pretty White Shoelaces
lista.descripcion: My Pretty White Shoelaces | Hikers in Portland discover the badly decomposed body of a raped and strangled young girl; A month later, another woman turns up brutally murdered in same fashion; the prime suspect is a homeless drifter harboring dark sexual fantasies.

lista.titulo: Signs of a Psychopath • Make Sure You Get My Good Side
lista.descripcion: Make Sure You Get My Good Side | A road rage incident turns deadly as an elderly man is beaten to death by a teenager who claims he was acting in self-defense; detectives not only find holes in his story but uncover that he is a remorseless and manipulative psychopath.

lista.titulo: Signs of a Psychopath • Unorthodox and Weird

lista.titulo: Married to Evil • Deadly Delivery
lista.descripcion: Deadly Delivery | A successful Florida family has their American dream shattered when a mysterious figure dressed as a clown shoots a loving mother on her doorstep; the case goes cold for decades until an unexpected break helps bring the killer clown to justice.

lista.titulo: Married to Evil • Dying to Leave
lista.descripcion: Dying to Leave | After years of abuse, Cheryl musters the courage to leave her husband, Thom; he stalks her and torments their two children; when Cheryl finds a new love, her ex sets a trap to take the ultimate revenge.

lista.titulo: Married to Evil • Out of Control
lista.descripcion: Out of Control | When Angie meets Joe, her family and friends aren't sure what to make of their relationship; the couple marry and have kids, but soon Angie becomes isolated from her loved ones and trapped in a spiral of abuse that ends in a horrific triple homicide.

lista.titulo: Married to Evil • Home Is Where the Nightmare Is
lista.descripcion: Home Is Where the Nightmare Is | Jenny and Mike are teen sweethearts but after marrying, Mike begins a campaign of control and violence against his wife and children; just as Jenny plans to escape her living nightmare, Mike finds out and decides he will do anything to stop her.

lista.descripcion: Why Would Someone Shoot Amanda? | Amanda Blackburn and her unborn child are killed during a home invasion; with no forced entry and few leads, investigators have to piece together scattered clues, surveillance footage, stolen items and witness accounts.

lista.titulo: People Magazine Investigates: The University of Cosmic Intelligence Cult
lista.descripcion: Rashad Jamal rises online as a self-proclaimed prophet, creating a cult that mixes cosmic teachings with conspiracy. His University of Cosmic Intelligence spreads fast, but when some of his followers vanish, fear grows that devotion has turned deadly.
